svg.data-sequence: Drop impact; Discretization via Reference-Onto-surface Projection; Polarization; Smooth SvdW-DROP cavity; GOSTSHYP pressure; Discretization via Reference-Onto-surface Projection; Self-consistent reaction field; Solvent-excluded-surface definition
svg.title: MOIST — solvation animations — dark palette
svg.desc: Drop impact flows into a forward-only projection restoring the absent o. Then the remaining sequences follow: Polarization, Smooth SvdW-DROP cavity, GOSTSHYP pressure, Discretization via Reference-Onto-surface Projection, Self-consistent reaction field, Solvent-excluded-surface definition. 75-second loop. Shared vector artwork and CSS animation only. Each sequence returns to its initial logo. Reduced motion shows the initial logo.
